title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Acts 16: Timothy joins Paul, the vision of Macedonia, Lydia, and the jailer at Philippi.

questions.text: Who was the disciple at Derbe and Lystra whose mother was a Jewish believer and whose father was a Greek?
questions.explanation: Acts 16:1 names him as Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, while his father was a Greek.

answers.text: Silas
Timothy
Barnabas
John called Mark

questions.text: Where were they forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word?
questions.explanation: Having gone through Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

answers.text: In Macedonia
In Galatia
In Troas
In Asia

questions.text: What did the man of Macedonia say in the vision that appeared to Paul in the night?
questions.explanation: He stood begging him and saying, "Come over into Macedonia and help us."

answers.text: Come over into Macedonia and help us
Go back quickly to Jerusalem
Preach the word in Asia also
Follow me as far as Rome

questions.text: What is said about Lydia, who heard them by the riverside?
questions.explanation: She was a seller of purple from the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, and the Lord opened her heart.

answers.text: She was a servant girl with a spirit of divination
She was the wife of the jailer of the prison
She was a seller of purple from the city of Thyatira
She was a Jewess married to a Greek

questions.text: What did the girl with a spirit of divination cry out as she followed Paul and his companions?
questions.explanation: She cried out that these men were servants of the Most High God, who proclaimed a way of salvation.

answers.text: These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim a way of salvation
These men are enemies of Caesar and of all his decrees
Away with these men out of our city and our marketplace
A great light has shone upon our city today

questions.text: What was done to Paul and Silas after they were brought before the magistrates?
questions.explanation: They were beaten with rods, thrown into the inner prison, and their feet were secured in the stocks.

answers.text: They were stoned and dragged out of the city as dead
They were put on a ship and sent away to Rome
They were released after a public warning by the magistrates
They were beaten with rods and put in the stocks in the inner prison

questions.text: What were Paul and Silas doing about midnight, before the earthquake?
questions.explanation: About midnight they were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

answers.text: Sleeping in the inner prison
Pleading with the jailer to let them go
Praying and singing hymns to God
Teaching the magistrates of the city

questions.text: What did Paul cry out when the jailer drew his sword?
questions.explanation: Paul cried with a loud voice, "Don't harm yourself, for we are all here!"

answers.text: Flee, for the prisoners have escaped
Don't harm yourself, for we are all here
Open the gate, for the Lord has set us free
Call for lights and count the prisoners

questions.text: What did Paul and Silas answer when the jailer asked what he must do to be saved?
questions.explanation: They said, "Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household."

answers.text: Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved
Be circumcised and keep the law of Moses
Give your goods to the brothers
Go to Jerusalem and offer a sacrifice

questions.text: Why were the magistrates afraid when the sergeants reported Paul's words?
questions.explanation: They were afraid when they heard that the men they had beaten publicly without a trial were Romans.

answers.text: Because the prison had been shaken by an earthquake
Because their own jailer had believed
Because they heard that Paul and Silas were Romans
Because the multitude had turned against them
